MINUTES
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  DECEMBER 17, 2018

  A regular meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was
  called to order at 7:00 p.m. in the Council Chamber at Rolling Hills Estates City Hall, 4045 Palos
  Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California by CHAIR ROMANELLI.

  2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  CHAIR ROMANELLI led those present in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  CHAIR ROMANELLI recognized Judy Bain and Ryan McComick, whose appointment on
  the Park and Activities Commission begins on January 1, 2019.

  CHAIR ROMANELLI thanked the Park and Activities Commission for their comments and
  contributions to the commission and wished them a Merry Christmas and Happy 2019.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  COMMISSIONERS PRESENT:  Persichina, Ciarolla, Romanelli, Pope, Wroan

  COMMISSIONERS ABSENT:  Retz

  STAFF PRESENT:  Andy Clark, Community Services Director
  Daniel A-Haja, Senior Recreation Leader
  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES NOVEMBER 19, 2018

  COMMISSIONER WROAN made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER POPE to:

  APPROVE THE PARKS AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF
  NOVEMBER 19, 2018.

  There being no objection, CHAIR ROMANELLI so ordered.

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA

  None

  6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  None

  7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  “BUTCHER PARK” REVISED CONCEPTUAL DESIGN

  Community Services Director Clark provided a summary of the staff report and stated that
  a second community meeting was held and there was very good input. Specific
  suggestions made at the meeting were to install timber form steppers, a classic timber
  form wide-shoe climber with a slide, and the elimination of the pole climber.

  Community Services Director Clark stated that staff recommends that the Park and
  Activities Commission makes a recommendation to the City Council to approve the
  “Butcher Park” conceptual plan and cost estimate and direct BMLA to prepare the plans
  and specifications for the bidding of this park development project.

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI stated that he would like the Park and Activities
  Commission to provide recommendations for the name of the park.

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES,  1
DECEMBER 17, 2018
   COMMISSIONER POPE asked about the December 6, 2018 community meeting.
  Community Services Director Clark stated that all who came to the first community
  meeting were invited to participate in the second meeting and those in attendance provide
  their input.

  Paolo Brinderson, Palos Verdes Estates Troop 276, stated that he is working to get his
  Eagle Scout Award, and for his project, is interested in building park benches for this park
  and planting trees and bushes around them. He is proposing a rustic design to go with the
  design of the park. Mr. Brinderson provided a photograph of the design to the Park and
  Activities Commission. CHAIR ROMANELLI asked about his experience. Mr. Brinderson
  stated that he will be working with someone who has construction experience.
  Commissioner Pope stated that this is a wonderful project and the commissioner’s
  concurred.

  COMMISSIONER WROAN made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER POPE to,

  MAKE A RECOMMENDATION TO THE CITY COUNCIL TO APPROVE THE
  “BUTCHER PARK” CONCEPTUAL PLAN AND COST ESTIMATE AND DIRECT
  BMLA TO PREPARE THE PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS FOR THE BIDDING
  OF THIS PARK DEVELOPMENT PROJECT. IN ADDITION, TO ALLOW PAOLO
  BRENDERSON, PALOS VERDES TROOP 276, TO DESIGN AND BUILD PARK
  BENCHES AND INSTALL TREES AND SHRUBS FOR THE PARK.

  AYES: PERSICHINA, CIAROLLA, ROMANELLI, POPE, WROAN
  NOES:
  ABSENT: RETZ
  ABSTAIN:

  B.  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER PATIO RE-DESIGN

  Community Services Director Clark thanked COMMISSIONER CIAROLLA for meeting
  with staff regarding the City Hall Council Chamber patio re-design and stated that Sean
  Bennett, Bennett Landscaping also attended the meeting. It was decided that a flat patio
  would be best due to the various uses of the patio and in addition, three small planters will
  be installed. The cost to install the patio would be $8,400 and the landscaping would be
  $1,240.

  Community Services Director Clark stated that staff recommends that the Park and
  Activities Commission make a recommendation to the City Council to install a concrete
  pad and perimeter landscaping for the redesign of the City Hall Council Chambers patio.

  COMMISSIONER CIAROLLA stated that Italian Hawthorne shrubs and the West
  Australian Peppermint Willow tree would fit in well in the space. Community Director Clark
  added that these are green year-round.

  In response to a question by COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI, COMMISSIONER
  CIAROLLA stated that the trees are recommendations by Sean Bennett, Bennett
  Landscaping and they do not have invasive roots.

  COMMISSIONER CIAROLLA made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  PERSICHENA to,

  THAT CITY COUNCIL APPROVE THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES
  COMMISSION’S RECOMMENDATION TO INSTALL A CONCRETE PAD
  AND PERIMETER LANDSCAPING THAT WILL INCLUDE THE
  INSTALLATION OF AN AUSTRALIAN PEPPERMINT WILLOW TREE AND
  ITALIAN HAWTHORNE SHRUBS FOR THE REDESIGN OF THE CITY
  HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER’S PATIO.

  AYES: PERSICHINA, CIAROLLA, ROMANELLI, POPE, WROAN
  NOES:
  ABSENT: RETZ
  ABSTAIN:

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES,  2
DECEMBER 17, 2018
   C.  COMMITTEE AND SUBCOMMITTEE ASSIGNMENTS

  The Park and Activities Commissioners expressed interest in serving on the following
  Committees/Subcommittees:

  COMMISSIONER CIAROLLA:  Equestrian Committee
  Hills Are Alive Subcommittee
  City Celebration Subcommittee

  COMMISSIONER POPE:  Traffic and Safety Committee
  Tracey Austin Tennis Tournament Subcommittee
  Parade of Lights Subcommittee
  City Celebration Subcommittee

  CHAIR ROMANELLI:  Tracey Austin Tennis Tournament Subcommittee
  Hills Area Alive Subcommittee

  COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA:  Hills Are Alive Subcommittee
  Parade of Lights Subcommittee

  CHANGES TO ADOPT-A-PARK ASSIGNMENTS ARE AS FOLLOWS:

  COMMISSIONER POPE from Highridge Park to Silver Spur Park

  Community Services Director Clark stated that the list will be completed after the
  orientation meeting for the new commissioners. A complete list will be provided at the next
  Park and Activities Commission meeting.

  COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  CIAROLLA to,

  ACCEPT THE COMMITTEE/SUBCOMMITTEE ASSIGNMENTS AS STATED.

  There being no objection, CHAIR ROMANELLI so ordered.

  D.  ERNIE HOWLETT PARK REGULATIONS AND FESTIVALS

  CHAIR ROMANELLI stated that Community Services Director Clark and Sr. Recreation
  Leader A-Haja held a meeting to discuss the park regulations and festival permits,
  particularly at Ernie Howlett Park. Being that there are more events and festivals at the
  park, there was discussion on whether the current park regulations and permits need to
  be updated. There was also discussion on limits to the size of canopies, photography and
  film regulations to include business license requirements. Also, if a person has a permit to
  use the horse arena, language needs to be included to allow the community to share the
  arena, since it is a public park/horse arena first. In addition, there is a need to address
  festival permits and it was determined that the fee would be $1/person.

  Community Services Director Clark stated that staff will put together the revised
  regulations and present them to the Park and Activities Commission at the next meeting
  and then it will be presented to the City Council for approval.

  COMMISSIONER POPE expressed her concern with giving the perception that it is
  excessively difficult to hold an event at the park. She also asked if there is a different fee
  for a non-profit organization. Community Services Director stated that only non-profits are
  granted event or festival permits and also confirmed that limitations on larger party permits
  have been addressed.

  This item was RECEIVED AND FILED.

  E.  JANUARY 2019 COMMISSION MEETING DATES

  Sr. Recreation Leader A-Haja stated that due to the Martin Luther King, Jr. Holiday falling
  on January 21st, which is the date of the next Park and Activities Commission meeting,
  staff recommends that this meeting be adjourned to January 14th at 6:00 p.m. after the
  parade debriefing meeting.
PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES,  3
DECEMBER 17, 2018
   The Park and Activities Commissioners agreed to adjourn to January 14 at 6:00 p.m. if the
  meeting is needed.

  F.  PROPOSED SUMMER MOVIE FILMS

  Sr. Recreation Leader A-Haja that staff pre-selected the following movie choices for the
  2019 Summer Movie Program. 1) Alladin 2) The Lego Movie 3) Toy Story 4) Frozen. These
  were selected due to their sequels in the summer of 2019.

  Sr. Recreation Leader A-Haja stated that staff recommends that the Park and Activities
  Commission select the movies to be shown during the 2019 Summer Movie Program.

  COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER POPE
  to,
  APPROVE THE MOVIE SELECTIONS, FROZEN, THE LEGO MOVIEW, AND
  TOY STORY FOR THE 2019 SUMMER MOVIE PROGRAM.

  AYES: PERSICHINA, CIAROLLA, ROMANELLI, POPE, WROAN
  NOES:
  ABSENT: RETZ
  ABSTAIN:

  8.  COMMISSION ITEMS (Verbal Reports)

  A.  ADOPT-A-PARK REPORTS

  NO REPORTS

  9.  DIRECTOR’S ITEMS (Verbal Reports)

  A.  CITY COUNCIL MEETING COMMISSIONER ATTENDANCE SCHEDULE

  Community Services Director stated that the City Council attendance schedule is included
  in the packet.

  Community Services Director stated that there was a Youth Sports Committee Meeting
  and asked for a brief overview of the meeting in regards to the Junior Baseball League.

  COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA stated there was a review of the conditions which were
  drawn up for the Youth Sports to follow. This will be the Junior Baseball League’s second
  year and enrollment is increasing. COMMISSIONER WROAN stated that there is
  improvement with the program and more participation.

  10.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF NOVEMBER 28, 2018

  CHAIR ROMANELLI stated that the action taken on bougainvillea being planted in the
  medians was not approved. Community Services Director stated that this will be discussed
  at the policy development session in addition to repairs needed in the medians.

  B.  PLANNING COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES OF DECEMBER 3, 2018

  C.  EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE DRAFT MINUTES OF NOVEMBER 26, 2018

  11.  FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  A.  RACE AGREEMENT REVIEW

  None

  COMMISSIONER POPE stated that she would like to commend staff on a great event
  (referring to the Holiday Parade of Lights).

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES,  4
DECEMBER 17, 2018
   12.  ADJOURNMENT

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER POPE
  to,
  ADJOURN THE MEETING AT 7:45 P.M. TO THE NEXT PARK AND ACTIVITIES
  COMMISSION MEETING ON JANUARY 14, 2019 AT 6:00 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL
  CHAMBER AT CITY HALL, 4045 PALOS VERDES DRIVE NORTH, ROLLING
  HILLS ESTATES.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,
